purpose: Compare the XuanTie-E902 large-workload GPU crossover search gate with a matching single-process CPU repeated-eval loop.
preconditions: XuanTie host probe is built with make -C src/hybrid xuantie_e902_host_probe
reports/xuantie_e902_large_workload_scaling.json exists when CPU/GPU comparison fields are requested

allowed_claims: single-process CPU repeated eval_step wall time for XuanTie-E902 at the large-workload gate shapes
GPU repeated kernel-launch throughput for XuanTie-E902 at the same gate shapes
CPU/GPU state-step throughput ratio for the first non-TL-UL large-workload gate
non_claims: not a full RTL application throughput claim
not a broad non-TL-UL generality claim
CPU repeated steps are modeled as repeated eval_step calls after initialization
comparison_policy.next_precision_step: decide whether XuanTie-E902 has enough large-workload evidence to package the first non-TL-UL throughput boundary or needs a larger memory-resident workload
